reason: Section 4 amends Section 21 of EO 11264: it deletes the United States Information Agency from the list in subsection (b)(2), adds a new paragraph (b)(3) for two United States Information Agency officials designated by the Director, and conforms subsection (d). Under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling (2026-10-21) an amending clause continues, amended, until the parent order ends. The parent here is Section 21 of EO 11264 (Part II, the Board of the Foreign Service), which EO 12292 did not revoke (Sec. 10(h) revoked only Part III); Section 4 of EO 11434 was left unrevoked by Sec. 10(i). EO 12363 (signed 1982-05-21; 47 FR 22497) said in its Sec. 3: "Executive Order No. 11264 of December 31, 1965, as amended, is revoked." and states no later effective date, so the end is recorded as 1982-05-21. The amendment is a rewrite of part of a section that no longer existed after that date, and the Board it concerned was replaced by the Board of the Foreign Service established by Sec. 9 of EO 12293, as added by Sec. 1 of EO 12363. EO 12553 (signed 1986-02-25; Federal Register of March 3, 1986, Vol. 51, No. 41) revokes EO 11434 together with "any amendments thereto"; it is recorded as the formal disposition and is listed as a later event, but it is dated after this clause had ended and is not the first end.
